posts.title: Jay Clayton to lead Trump's AI task force, deliver report in 120 days, WSJ reports
posts.summary: Reuters→WSJ/CNBC (Oct 3 ~22:45 UTC — NEW): DNI Jay Clayton confirms he will lead White House “Super Intelligence Force” (SI) with a 120-day report on AI risks/opportunities and federal oversight — upgrades prior “expected AI czar” item into formal task-force leadership; pairs with held voluntary-safeguards accord (Reuters direct 401 this slot; real reuters.com URL kept).

posts.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Oct 3 ~16:30 UTC — held; Verge/Guardian/Atlantic same cluster): OpenAI Safety Systems leader David Robinson resigns after ~3.5 years — Atlantic essay says company “culture is broken,” Silicon Valley sprint optimism blocks nuclear/aviation-grade safeguards — still strongest weekend safety/policy lead beside held rogue-agent notices + internal shutdown-restart.

posts.title: Amazon responds to data center backlash, says it no longer uses NDAs

posts.title: Deepmind researchers propose "Artificial Symbiotic Intelligence" as an alternative to the singularity

posts.title: As public fears of AI grow, Trump digs in on voluntary safeguards
posts.summary: Reuters (Oct 3 ~12:34 UTC — held): White House “morally binding” voluntary AI safety accord with Nvidia, SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Google — robust internal controls + independent auditors but no stated enforcement — still top US AI-policy hold beside NEW Super Intelligence Force.

posts.title: Open-source "BootLoops" harness supports AI models in performing precise scientific calculations
